MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on January 15, 2026 by and between LexiTech Solutions Inc. ("Client") and CloudScale Services LLC ("Provider").

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
Provider shall render cloud migration and technical consulting services as specified in Statements of Work.

2. TERM AND TERMINATION
This Agreement commences on February 1, 2026 and shall terminate on January 31, 2027. Either party may terminate with 30 days prior written notice.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT TERMS
Client agrees to pay Provider a fixed fee of $15,000 per month. Invoices are payable net 30 days from the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

4. INDEMNIFICATION AND LIABILITY
Provider shall indemnify Client against third-party IP infringement claims. Client shall indemnify Provider against all claims arising from Client content.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY
Both parties agree to protect proprietary information for a period of three (3) years following termination.
